:::{#thm-gauss-score}
#### Score function of a Gaussian variable

Let $X \sim \ndist{\pmean, \ss}$, with mean $\pmean$, known variance $\ss$, and observed value $x$.
The [score](#def-score) $\score$ of the single observation $x$
is the derivative of its log-likelihood $\loglik$ with respect to $\pmean$.
It equals the deviation of $x$ from the mean $\E{X}$,
divided by the variance $\Var{X}$:

$$\score = \frac{x - \E{X}}{\Var{X}} = \frac{x - \pmean}{\ss}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-gauss-score-fn, worked in @sol-gauss-score-fn.

:::
